### 2026-11-01: I finished the PCB for my stopwatch

**5h**

I finished the PCB for my stopwatch

I started out with a ESP32C3, 3 push buttons for start, stop, and restart, and an OLED. Heres the starting components:

### 2026-11-01: I made a case and and the firmware for the stopwatch!

**2h**

I made a case and and the firmware for the stopwatch!

The case took me a while cause im still not good with CAD, but i used onshape and put in a few fillets to make it sorta look retro (i dunno, is it retro)

I just had the green board exported, the buttons were off to the side so i didn't have them to model after:

![Screenshot 2026-11-01 221303](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/5EWBwlE4sonQmfnJte8X5LrEfrhjWaIo/823703745dd38bf8e9a5ebfa19d6c657ea6b4a1c507b3dced71dfd75da9be5bf.png)

Turns out you can just make the extrude a thin and it'll do the walls for you, something that would have been helpful to know last week.

SO i added a little cover, because without it its just a  tray:

![Screenshot 2026-11-01 221504](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/5EWBwlE4sonQmfnJte8X5LrEfrhjWaIo/1df2a4e099947c001226ff1c197bb60a28b8522114236325d7b1d66f7a8e8306.png)
 and then added chamfers:

![Screenshot 2026-11-01 221742](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/5EWBwlE4sonQmfnJte8X5LrEfrhjWaIo/68c356ebe8d7a159f7c8fe5de5837496d46f669485f8ce5ef32b1c5159ce77e8.png)

and also I did a cut in the back to plug it in, its wayy oversized:

![Screenshot 2026-11-01 221753](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/5EWBwlE4sonQmfnJte8X5LrEfrhjWaIo/4c0735d2b821d14d467f2dd05dec329b8c07d01fc7ca6e56266e521552f18395.png)
